title: Sheets
text: Sheets. They are a nice crisp sheet.  A little tight to put on bed but fits. I really love them, I think they will be softer after a few washes.  Will buy again.

product_metadata.title: 100% Cotton Pillow Cases Queen Size - Cooling, Breathable & Soft Pillowcase Covers Set of 2-400 Thread Count - King Size Pillow Case Available - Luxury Linen Pillowcases Queen Size 2 Pack
features: QUEEN SIZE PILLOW CASES: Set of two luxurious, hotel-quality, 100% Cotton Pillowcases. We take pride in offering the softest Queen Pillowcase Set at an affordable price for our customers; durable, fade-resistant, and long-lasting for many years of happy sleeping.

400 THREAD COUNT COTTON: These 400 Thread Count Pillowcases are woven with the finest long staple cotton yarns. It’s so important that your pillow covers are soft and comfortable; that’s why we use a high-quality sateen weave to provide that true cotton feel that people have enjoyed for years.

NATURAL 100% COTTON SHEETS: Our sheets are made in India with 100% Natural Cotton to ensure the best quality for our customers. The eco-friendly, natural, long-staple cotton yarns are what give these pillowcases their extra soft and durable qualities. Because they have no synthetic fibers, these 100% cotton pillowcases will get softer with each wash, stay fresh, and provide you with a luxurious and healthy sleep environment for years to come!

KEEP COOL WITH BREATHABLE COTTON: Cool, comfortable and very soft, all while maintaining a bit of crispness, these CGK Linens are well loved by our customers. If you’re a hot sleeper and need cooling bed sheets, then our moisture wicking, all natural cotton pillow cases will be great for you!

PEACE OF MIND: Our team’s first priority is keeping you happy with your purchase! We are passionate about what we do and proud of the products we offer. If you have any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We will be quick to respond!
description: Made in India from 100% Cotton Long Staple Yarns; this set of two Queen Size Pillowcases is crisp and fresh, and will provide you with a comfort that no microfiber or polyester fabric can compare to.!
- 100% long staple cotton provides a soft & silky strength that lasts!
- Made from all-natural, chemical free, 100% Cotton!
- Long Staple Cotton and Smooth Sateen Weave !
- True and tested 400 thread count Sheets!
- Fits mattresses perfectly up to 14” and won’t slide off the mattress!
- Easy to maintain with warm machine wash and light drying cycles!
- Two 400 Thread Count Queen Size Pillowcases: (20x30)!

Luxurious sleep begins with quality, luxurious sheets. If you’re like most people, you’ll love the comfortable feel of 100% cotton sheets when you climb into bed each night. It’s like having your own personal cloud to snuggle into. And we believe the sateen weave leaves you feeling like royalty after a healthy night’s sleep. !

Studies have shown that we spend approximately one third of our lives in bed sleeping and that sleep is a key component of overall good health. That’s why we use 100% Natural Cotton, of the highest quality. Since cotton sheets have a natural cooling effect you will enjoy a more refreshing sleep environment than with artificial fabrics such as microfiber, polyesters, or nylon.!
